thesis: The episode introduces Scott Wilson, the chief investment officer at Washington University of St. Louis, who oversees a $10 billion endowment and previously worked at Grinnell College. The conversation covers Wilson's upbringing in Alaska, his basketball experience at Grinnell, and his transition from a desire to be an engineer to a career in finance, including his early Wall Street experience in equity research and derivatives across New York, London, and Tokyo.
